name: testimonial-stack
title: Testimonial Stack
description: Testimonial stack for landing pages: the top card flips to the back every few seconds, the stack re-settles with springs, and dots track the position. Built on shadcn Card and Button. Ships with placeholder copy. Hover: auto-play pauses and the stack fans out. Disabled (or reduced motion): auto-play stops; disabled also disables the arrows.
